name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::cMaterialAttributes
notes: Lane RO. Constructor, folded into our class (members default-built). Reached only by the factory 0xaaa3c0; tested through the factory. The vtable 0xe76188 is referenced only by this constructor and the destructor 0xaa9fe0, so with the factory ours no live object carries it.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::destructor
notes: Lane RO. Destructor body, called only from slot 15. Ours is the compiler's destructor over our own containers; the test releases every reference at the end of each random run and checks the freed block count.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::scalar_deleting_destructor
notes: Lane RO. Slot 15, destructor then sized delete of 0x28; reached through Release. Mutants release-no-delete and release-result killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::AddAttribute
notes: Lane RO. Slot 4 AddAttribute(name, source): group by source->GetGroupKey(), width, size, fill (the source calls in that order), then the group sorted by name ignoring case with the toolchain's std::sort, which matches the image's introsort for ties. Mutants sort-case-sensitive, stable-sort, no-sort, width-after-fill killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::ReadAttribute
notes: Lane RO. Slot 14 ReadAttribute(source, index): source->ConsumeData(group[index] data); the result is ConsumeData's. Absent key is undefined in the original (null deref), ours returns 0; the test avoids it. Mutants read-index, read-result killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::IsEmpty
notes: Lane RO. Slot 6, true when there are no groups. Mutant isempty killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::Create
notes: Lane RO. Factory: a new cMaterialAttributes, refcount 1. Hooked (Hooks.nGZSceneGraph_cMaterialAttributes_Create); SG_MaterialAttributes_Create checks the fresh state and allocation blocks and bytes against the original, and that the final release frees.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::GetGroupKey
notes: Lane RO. Slot 8 GetGroupKey(n): the nth key in key order. n at or past the count is undefined in the original; the test stays inside. Mutant groupkey-nth killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::GetAttribute
notes: Lane RO. Slot 13 GetAttribute(out, index, key): name, index, width, flat position (index times width plus the values of the groups before). Absent key gives a zeroed out; index past the end is undefined in the original, avoided. Mutants get-position, get-index killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::FindAttribute
notes: Lane RO. Slot 12 FindAttribute(out, name, key): the first attribute of that name ignoring case (lower_bound over the sorted group) with the whole 16-byte out written; zeroed when absent. Mutants find-position, find-no-name-check, find-no-zero, find-case-sensitive killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::GetValueCount
notes: Lane RO. Slot 10 GetValueCount(key): a group's attribute count times its first width, 0 for none. Mutant valuecount-width killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::GetTotalValueCount
notes: Lane RO. Slot 11 GetTotalValueCount: the sum of every group's count times width. Exercised with valuesbefore (mutant killed).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::GetName
notes: Lane RO. Slot 5 GetName: the name's chars, null for an empty name. Mutant getname-empty killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::GetAttributeCount
notes: Lane RO. Slot 9 GetAttributeCount(key): the original returns count plus 1 for a present group (a sentinel entry), 0 for none; ours keeps that. Mutant attrcount killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::QueryInterface
notes: Lane RO. Slot 0 QueryInterface: accepts iid 1 and the attributes iid, adds a reference, stores this. Mutants qi-second-iid, qi-no-addref killed. AddRef, Release and the count are folded shared bodies (shared_vf_148fb0, 16e890, 15e970): ours implement them for our objects, the game's stay unclaimed and are not hooked.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cMaterialAttributes::SetName
notes: Lane RO. Slot 3 SetName(name): assigns the string and returns a pointer to it. Mutant setname-result killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::OpenNameCell
notes: Lane RO. cdecl (cell, name): name nonzero opens the cell with flag 0, else the cell's value becomes 0xffffffff; returns the cell. Hooked (Hooks.nGZSceneGraph_OpenNameCell); cMaterialParser calls ours. SG_OpenNameCell compares against the original (fake service cache) for both cases. Mutants cell-flag, cell-invalid killed.
